business_problem: CodaMetrix needed a better way to support autonomous medical coding from clinical documentation through billing submission because poor observability, fragmented tooling, and strict PHI governance requirements made it hard to scale coding models without denials and compliance risk.
solution_summary: CodaMetrix uses Databricks Data + AI Platform to support autonomous medical coding from clinical documentation through billing submission. The implementation replaced a legacy state where poor observability, fragmented tooling, and strict PHI governance requirements made it hard to scale coding models without denials and compliance risk. Clinical documentation and patient encounters move through Lakeflow Jobs and Spark Declarative Pipelines and land in Delta Lake, giving teams one trusted data foundation. Central governance keeps access, lineage, and compliance consistent across downstream teams. Databricks SQL, MLflow, and Model Serving operationalize models, agents, and analytics that deliver billable code predictions and claims-ready coding decisions.
business_outcome: CodaMetrix improved autonomous medical coding from clinical documentation through billing submission with measurable results including Automating 100K+ medical codes for faster reimbursement, 30% reduction in aws compute costs, and 40% improvement in operational efficiency, while giving teams a faster path from governed data to production decisions.
metrics: Automating 100K+ medical codes for faster reimbursement
architecture_clues: Delta Lake provides the shared storage layer for curated lakehouse datasets.
Automated ingestion and transformation pipelines keep source data synchronized for downstream analytics and AI.
Operational AI workflows are deployed directly beside governed data and analytics assets.
Automating 100K+ medical codes for faster reimbursement
evidence_quotes: Databricks is our single trust store for saving all these messages in a HIPAA-certified, safe and secure manner,

We’re responsible for handling PHI, which requires being able to conduct thorough audits and report incidents. When we were using other platforms, it was very difficult to keep track of who was doing what,
When you don’t work from standardized patient records, it’s a very noisy problem,
Databricks dashboards have shown to be a significant improvement. We’re now powering internal dashboards with materialized views, which can be streaming in nature or scheduled through SDP pipelines.
